about: The game folders tacompat runs: each is the retail 3.1 game as a player has it, plus what a mod or patch install puts next to it (fixtures.json), plus the ddraw.dll under test. 'add' entries apply in order: 'files' is a list of names, '*' for the whole fixture, or {"name in the folder": "name in the fixture"}. 'goal' is what the setup should do: Impure active with the mod's own exe and files as the player has them, and none of TADR's code run -- 'tadr_ran' false, judged two ways on every peer: nothing of TADR's in the game folder (no tdrawlog.txt, no recorder log) AND no site of the game's own code leading into a TADR module, read out of the running process -- in single player and, on Wine, in a two-player network game. 'today', where present, is the behaviour accepted until the takeover of TADR and the loaders reaches that setup (a KNOWN GAP); the commit that makes a setup meet its goal deletes its 'today'. The wiki's Compatibility section (research/notes/compat/) explains every route and outcome. 'tadr_started' allows the one thing the routes where TADR's DllMain loads Impure cannot avoid -- its first log line, written before Impure exists -- and nothing else: no engine patch, no recorder log, and no site of the game's code leading into TADR. 'no_network_game' says why a setup plays no two-player game, in words, measured: the walk of the battle room does not reach a game there. 'levers' are empty files the setup puts in the game folder, a DLL switch; a setup with one is a check of the harness or of a safety net, not a player's folder.

setups.name: retail
setups.about: the control: Impure alone on the retail exe

setups.name: retail+tadr1
setups.about: the 2006 recorder, Dplayx.dll, beside Impure; the retail exe loads it as its DirectPlay

setups.name: retail+tadr1-recorder
setups.about: the check that the evidence can fire at all: the 2006 recorder with the takeover switched off (tagpu_takeover.off) runs, answers the exe's DirectPlay and hooks the engine, and the suite must see both -- its log, and the sites of the game's code that lead into it, read out of the running process. Without this a 'tadr_ran: false' elsewhere could be a check that cannot see anything

setups.name: retail+tadr-recorder-ota
setups.about: a 2026 recorder build as the retail exe's own DirectPlay: tadr-recorder-ota's tplayx.dll renamed dplayx.dll, which binds because every recorder exports the DirectPlay ordinals the exe imports (1, 2, 4). The control for a recorder that is not the 2006 one: the takeover must make its entry point inert too, and the marker test must recognise a build it has not been shown

setups.name: retail+tadr-files
setups.about: a modern tdraw.dll and tplayx.dll left in the folder: nothing on the retail exe loads them

setups.name: loader+tadr-ota
setups.about: the Community Patch route on the retail exe: the Patch Loader as dplayx.dll asks for tdraw.dll after Impure has installed its limits, and Impure answers for it (the takeover), so TADR does not start

setups.name: loader+tadr-tazero
setups.about: a player's TA Zero install: the Patch Loader, TADR's tazero tdraw.dll and the 2022 community-patch recorder

setups.name: loader+tadr-mayhem
setups.about: the same route with TADR's Total Mayhem build and its recorder (the DLL layer only: the mod's own archives are not in the fixtures)

setups.name: 392+tadr-dev
setups.about: the 3.9.02 exe with a current TADR: tdraw.dll loads Impure from inside its own start-up

setups.name: 392+tadr-2026.8.6
setups.about: the 3.9.02 exe with the last stable TADR

setups.name: mayhem-11.3.0
setups.about: Total Mayhem 11.3.0 as installed, with Impure's ddraw.dll copied over the mod's cnc-ddraw: the stock exe, Mayhem's Patch Loader and its 2024 TADR, which the takeover keeps from starting; its loader moves the game's registry to Software\TotalM

setups.name: prota-4.8
setups.about: ProTA 4.8 as installed, with Impure's ddraw.dll copied over the mod's cnc-ddraw: the stock exe, ProTA's Patch Loader and its 2025 TADR, which the takeover keeps from starting; its loader moves the game's registry to Software\ProTA

setups.name: mayhem-11.3.0-net
setups.about: Total Mayhem 11.3.0 with the takeover switched off (tagpu_takeover.off): TADR starts and rewrites 17 of Impure's sites, and the safety net must stop the game at the first DirectDraw call instead of letting the first skirmish load crash

setups.name: gammata-ota
setups.about: gammata's drop-in with Impure's ddraw.dll copied over it: its tdraw.dll loads ddraw_custom.dll (cnc-ddraw), never ddraw.dll

setups.name: escalation
setups.about: Escalation GOLD 10.2.0 as installed: its exe imports TAESC.dll, which loads Impure from inside its start-up
setups.no_network_game: its battle room starts a game with no units on either peer -- both load the map and play, resources and HUD up and the camera in the world, with nothing to fight -- so the suite's fight cannot be applied (MEASURED 2026-09-27; the same setup applies 402 of 402 entities in a single-player skirmish, so it is the room's seating and not the engine)

setups.about: Escalation's exe and archives with the current TADR Escalation build in place of TAESC.dll
